description: Defines the TimeDate class for handling broadcast time synchronization, including nested classes Sink and Parser for notification and section parsing, with methods for scanning, loading time data, and managing tuner state.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Manages broadcast time synchronization, tuner notifications, and section parsing.

classes.name: TimeDate::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: TimeDate::Parser
classes.description: Implements ISection to parse DVB sections related to time data (TDT and TOT).

methods.name: TimeDate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TimeDate object and registering tuner notifications.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for time data based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation by removing it from the scanner list.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing from scanner list accordingly.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads time data from DVB::TOT or DVB::TDT tables.
